svg.text: LIVING PORTRAITS/ Architecture v2 (live build on supercommons2)

Self-aware theatrical portraits on two LED panels, free + local on SC2. Nothing runs in realtime: a deterministic PLAYER performs pre-baked beats; an async STAGE-MANAGER (qwen3) composes them; a generative pipeline backfills the art offline.

Legend: green = built & running · amber = next phase · cyan = in flight · violet = creative contract · red = pending (off-site). Reality: live loop screenshot-verified · gen stack installed (torch cu121, CUDA OK) · first SDXL portrait rendering now · physical LED mapping unconfirmed.
INPUTS / SIGNALS (director/signals.py) · the "important data" the world reacts to
data/feed.json STUB -> THE SIGNAL + Google Calendar + weather
DIRECTOR / BRAIN (director/stage_manager.py) · qwen3:8b via local Ollama · format=json · /no_think · --loop 45s
loop paused during portrait renders (frees VRAM), then resumes
action clamped to a fixed 7-verb vocabulary
CONTROL CHANNEL · the only seam between brain and stage
player mtime-polls ~2Hz · never reads a half-written file
PLAYER / STAGE (player.py) · pygame, borderless 448x256 @ (0,0), top-most + windowless (pythonw), console session 1
NEXT: action -> Live2D rig + baked clip
OUTPUT / EDGE · desktop framebuffer -> LED sending card -> panels
grabs the region, maps each sub-rect to a panel
only the physical card grab is unconfirmed (Ray off-site)
GENERATIVE PIPELINE · offline / async backfill · real portraits, rig + clips, verified into a library
runs detached on the 2080 Ti, slow is fine (not realtime)
Piper / Kokoro (free, local) + MuseTalk / LivePortrait bake
cached audio + visemes per aside · or stay silent-theatre (intertitle cards)
auto-restart on reboot · gallery state across restarts
remote box over a sometimes-flaky tailnet:
long jobs run as DETACHED tasks (survive
link drops) + tolerant polling, never a
live SSH pipe. Link fix: GUI relaunch /
Coexists politely with the catalog: director
sips qwen3 every 45s; renders unload qwen3
PRINCIPLES no-realtime · deterministic-player · async-generative-backfill · fourth-wall-always-on · verify-before-the-library · free-and-local · share-the-box-politely · long-jobs-detached

BUILT + VERIFIED TODAY player (top-most, windowless, screenshot-verified) · qwen3 stage-manager 45s loop · prompt library + 4th-wall contract · stage_state.json channel · gen stack (torch cu121, CUDA OK) · SDXL generator deployed + rendering · architecture SVG

NEXT PHASE finish first portrait -> SAM segment -> Live2D rig + img2vid/RIFE bridges -> verify gate -> clip library · player rig+clip playback · real feed wiring · TTS/lip-sync · self-heal watchdog · shared-KV · confirm LED mapping on-site

NOW first SDXL portrait rendering on SC2 (director paused for VRAM, resumes after) · tailnet link recovered mid-session via down/up cycle. projects/living-portraits/living-portraits-architecture-v2.svg · 2026-05-26 · supersedes v1
